State of emergency for the December 2002 ice storm, announced in the Governor's December 5, 2002 release "Gov. Easley Declares A State Of Emergency" (his December 9 release requests federal aid for the winter storm).
Statewide state of emergency for the record January 2000 snowstorm, declared January 25, 2000 (NPR that day; Hunt told CNN that morning he was prepared to call one).

coverage: 2000-present: the Governor's executive order archive from January 2017, plus 2000-2016 weather declarations (Hunt, Easley, Perdue and McCrory) added by hand from the State Archives of North Carolina's executive orders and Governor's press releases and dated news coverage; declarations for the February 2003 ice storm, the September 2010 floods, the late July 2013 mountain floods and the March 2014 ice storm have not been found, and some 2000-2016 orders that do not name their hazard are not listed
